plates.lake-full: A round blue lake ringed with green reeds and small white flowers, a flat warm stone at the near shore, dusty green fields beyond and a low pink-sandstone walled town far on the horizon under an ochre and marigold sky with sunburst rays.
plates.lake-dry: The same lake bed after a failed monsoon: shrunk to one small brown puddle in a wide plain of cracked dry mud, the reeds yellow and bent, the flat stone bare, the same pink-sandstone town small on the horizon under a hot pale sky.
plates.sky-gold: An empty warm sky filling the whole frame -- marigold and gold with a soft sunburst and a few cream clouds, and only a thin strip of distant hills along the very bottom.
plates.fields-air: A high aerial view over sunlit Rajasthan: patchwork green and gold fields, a winding dust road, scattered mango trees, and a low pink-sandstone walled town on the horizon.
plates.village-air: A high aerial view looking down a small sunlit village street: terracotta rooftops, a big neem tree, a stone well, mud-brick walls. Along the street and in the doorways about fifteen SMALL villagers in bright clothes -- men, women and children, several with one arm raised POINTING UP at the sky.
plates.lake-night: The same round lake full of blue water again at night: green reeds, a flat empty stone on the near shore, the town dark on the horizon, a deep indigo sky with the last gold of sunset low down and the first stars out.
